grammar.title: Comprehensively with 全面
grammar.explanation: 全面 (quánmiàn) means "comprehensively, in all respects" — describing an action or understanding that covers every aspect, not just part of it. It goes right before the verb.

sentences.zh: 老师全面检查了我们的作业。
sentences.pinyin: Lǎoshī quánmiàn jiǎnchá le wǒmen de zuòyè.
sentences.en: The teacher thoroughly checked our homework.

sentences.zh: 他全面介绍了这个计划。
sentences.pinyin: Tā quánmiàn jièshào le zhège jìhuà.
sentences.en: He gave a comprehensive introduction to this plan.

sentences.zh: 公司全面支持这个计划。
sentences.en: The company fully supports this plan.

sentences.zh: 这份报告全面说明了市场情况。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào quánmiàn shuōmíng le shìchǎng qíngkuàng.
sentences.en: This report comprehensively explains the market situation.
